encoder.scope: Foundations mono-red mirrors and passive 60-Mountain opponent

training: mono-red versus mono-red PPO; undiscounted terminal +1/-1/0 only; no imitation
evaluation: sampled policy, temperature 1; do-nothing 60-Mountain opponent; fixed held-out seeds
concession: Voluntary Concede is excluded from both training and evaluation; no other strategy masking
cutoffs: Excluded from PPO; retained as failed evaluation attempts

initialization.method: checkpoint weights; fresh optimizers and trainer RNG

validation_methodology: Whole-game holdout before outcome filtering; both seats stay together; training-only advantage normalization; validation never enters either optimizer. Policy surrogate gain is an outcome-based proxy, not a win rate. Legacy training_games fields count collected attempts; optimization/validation counts are explicit.
